ai-engineer.title: AI Engineer
ai-engineer.description: Designing and deploying LLM-based applications, fine-tuning models, and building RAG systems.
ai-engineer.why_now: Companies are migrating from 'AI-curious' to 'AI-native', requiring engineers who can integrate models into products.
ai-engineer.situation: Hyper-growth phase with extreme talent scarcity.
ai-engineer.scope: Big Tech, AI Startups, Enterprise R&D
ai-engineer.lifetime: 15+ years (Foundational for the next computing era)

prompt-engineer.title: Prompt Engineer
prompt-engineer.description: Optimizing inputs for LLMs to achieve consistent, high-quality results for enterprise automation.
prompt-engineer.why_now: Context window management and prompt chain optimization are now critical for production AI stability.
prompt-engineer.situation: Rapidly evolving; shifting from manual prompting to programmatic 'DSPy' style optimization.
prompt-engineer.scope: Marketing, Content Ops, Software Development Teams
prompt-engineer.lifetime: 3-5 years (Likely to be absorbed into standard SWE roles)

mlops-engineer.title: MLOps Engineer
mlops-engineer.description: The DevOps of AI — focusing on the deployment, scaling, and monitoring of machine learning models.
mlops-engineer.why_now: Enterprises have many models but few production-grade deployment pipelines.
mlops-engineer.situation: Critical bottleneck for enterprise AI adoption.

full-stack.title: Full Stack Developer (AI-Native)
full-stack.description: End-to-end product development using AI-assisted coding and integrating AI features natively.
full-stack.why_now: The bar for 'MVP' has risen; AI-native stacks (Next.js + Vercel + Supabase) are the new standard.
full-stack.situation: Evolving into 'Product Engineering' — focus on speed-to-market.

backend.title: Backend Engineer
backend.description: Building robust server-side logic, database architectures, and high-performance APIs.
backend.why_now: Data-heavy AI applications require highly optimized and secure backend infrastructures.
backend.situation: Stable but shift toward specialized high-performance systems.

frontend.title: Frontend Developer
frontend.description: Creating immersive, high-performance user interfaces and complex web-based dashboards.
frontend.why_now: Complex AI outputs require sophisticated visualization and real-time interaction patterns.
frontend.situation: Saturating; manual boilerplate coding is being automated by AI UI tools.

mobile-developer.title: Mobile Developer
mobile-developer.description: Building cross-platform or native mobile applications for iOS and Android.
mobile-developer.why_now: Mobile-first AI assistants are the primary interface for many consumers.

cloud-architect.title: Cloud Architect
cloud-architect.description: Designing large-scale cloud infrastructure and multi-cloud strategies.
cloud-architect.why_now: AI cloud bills are massive; efficiency and cost-optimization are now survivability traits.
cloud-architect.situation: Elite role; high barrier to entry due to complexity.

devsecops.title: DevSecOps Engineer
devsecops.description: Integrating automated security practices directly into the DevOps pipeline.
devsecops.why_now: AI-generated code introduces new security risks that must be caught automatically.
devsecops.situation: One of the most critical roles as cyber-threats become AI-powered.

devops.title: DevOps Engineer
devops.description: Managing deployment automation and infrastructure as code.
devops.why_now: Shift toward Platform Engineering and infrastructure that manages AI GPUs.

cyber-security-analyst.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
cyber-security-analyst.description: Protecting systems and networks by analyzing threats and responding to incidents.
cyber-security-analyst.why_now: Ransomware and AI-powered phishing are at an all-time high.
cyber-security-analyst.situation: Strong entry-level path; high demand for SoC analysts.

penetration-tester.title: Penetration Tester
penetration-tester.description: Ethical hacking to find vulnerabilities before the bad actors do.
penetration-tester.why_now: New attack vectors in LLMs and AI APIs require specialized 'Red Teaming' skills.
penetration-tester.situation: Elite, high-challenge role that rewards creative thinking.

data-engineer.title: Data Engineer
data-engineer.description: Building and maintaining the pipes that move and transform giant datasets.
data-engineer.why_now: AI is only as good as the data; high-quality data pipelines are the foundation of AI success.
data-engineer.situation: The 'hidden work' behind every AI project; demand is massive.

data-scientist.title: Data Scientist
data-scientist.description: Extracting insights from data using statistical models and ML algorithms.
data-scientist.why_now: Shift from simple dashboards to predictive AI-driven decision making.
data-scientist.situation: Maturing field; basic analysis is being automated by LLMs.

data-analyst.title: Data Analyst
data-analyst.description: Visualizing and interpreting data to answer business questions.
data-analyst.why_now: Low barrier to entry for AI-assisted data storytelling.
data-analyst.situation: High risk of automation for basic dashboarding tasks.

bi-analyst.title: BI Analyst
bi-analyst.description: Focusing on enterprise intelligence, reporting strategy, and warehouse mapping.
bi-analyst.why_now: Bridging the gap between raw data and executive strategy.
bi-analyst.situation: Stable; shifting toward strategic data advisory.

software-architect.title: Software Architect
software-architect.description: High-level design of system architectures, tech stack selection, and scalability patterns.
software-architect.why_now: AI makes individual coding fast, but makes system complexity grow exponentially. Architects are needed more than ever.
software-architect.situation: Apex software role; immune to automation of syntax.

api-design-specialist.title: API Design Specialist
api-design-specialist.description: Focusing exclusively on the contract and design of high-scale and developer-friendly APIs.
api-design-specialist.why_now: The 'API Economy' is the AI Economy; models communicate via APIs.

game-developer.title: Game Developer
game-developer.description: Using Unity or Unreal Engine to build games or interactive simulations.
game-developer.why_now: Generative AI for 3D assets and NPCs is fundamentally changing the build speed.
game-developer.situation: Passion-driven field with high specialized demand.

qa-engineer.title: QA Engineer (Automation)
qa-engineer.description: Ensuring software quality through rigorous automated testing and bug hunting.
qa-engineer.why_now: AI-generated code needs MORE testing, not less. Automation is now mandatory.
qa-engineer.situation: Manual testers are being phased out; automation engineers are moving to 'Quality Engineering'.

technical-writer.title: Technical Writer
technical-writer.description: Translating complex technical features into clear documentation and tutorials.
technical-writer.why_now: Good documentation is the training data for AI; clear docs make tools better.
technical-writer.situation: AI can write basic docs, but needs human experts for nuance and accuracy.

product-manager.title: Product Manager
product-manager.description: Defining the 'What' and 'Why' of a product, bridging engineering and business.
product-manager.why_now: Product intuition is the most valuable human trait when code becomes a commodity.
product-manager.situation: High-leverage role; focus on 'AI Native' UI patterns and value.

engineering-manager.title: Engineering Manager
engineering-manager.description: Managing people, team dynamics, and technical delivery.
engineering-manager.why_now: Managing remote AI-powered teams requires new empathy and coordination skills.
engineering-manager.situation: Stable; demand for leaders who understand high-performance engineering culture.
engineering-manager.scope: Mid to large scale tech companies

ux-designer.title: UX Designer
ux-designer.description: Designing how humans interact with digital products.
ux-designer.why_now: Traditional UI is boring; 'Generative UI' is the new frontier.

blockchain-developer.title: Blockchain Developer
blockchain-developer.description: Building decentralized applications and smart contracts.
blockchain-developer.why_now: The shift from 'hype' to 'enterprise ledger' infrastructure.

ar-vr-developer.title: AR/VR Developer
ar-vr-developer.description: Creating immersive experiences for headsets and spatial computing.
ar-vr-developer.why_now: Apple Vision Pro and Meta Quest 3 have reignited the 'Spatial Computing' market.

robotics-automation-engineer.title: Robotics & Automation Engineer
robotics-automation-engineer.description: Developing software that controls physical robotic systems and autonomous devices.
robotics-automation-engineer.why_now: The physical side of AI — humanoid robots and warehouse automation are scaling up.
robotics-automation-engineer.situation: Hard-tech role with significant barrier to entry.

python.title: Python Language Path
python.description: Learn the most versatile language used in AI, Data, and Backend.
python.why_now: The undisputed language of the AI era.

rust.title: Rust Language Path
rust.description: Deep-dive into the language of safety, performance, and low-level efficiency.
rust.why_now: Replacing C++ for high-performance AI inference and infrastructure.
rust.situation: Loved by developers; used for mission-critical infrastructure.
rust.scope: Cloud Infra, OS, Crypto, High-scale APIs

system-design.title: System Design Path
system-design.description: Master the principles of scalable and distributed software architecture.
system-design.why_now: Infrastructure complexity is the primary bottleneck in large AI products.
system-design.situation: The skill that separates Seniors from Juniors.

prompt-engineering.title: Prompt Engineering Path
prompt-engineering.description: Techniques for controlling LLMs through advanced input design.
prompt-engineering.why_now: The fastest way to unlock business value from AI.
prompt-engineering.situation: Hot but evolving into programmatic tuning.

ai-agents.title: AI Agents & Autonomous Systems
ai-agents.description: Building software that can think, plan, and use tools on its own.
ai-agents.why_now: The next evolution from Chatbots to active Agents (AutoGPT, CrewAI).

vibe-coding.title: Vibe Coding (AI-Native Dev)
vibe-coding.description: Mastering high-speed development using AI chat-based coding tools like Cursor.
vibe-coding.why_now: The revolution in developer productivity — from 'syntax writing' to 'architecting vibes'.

go.title: Go Language Path
go.description: Learn the simple, high-performance language behind Docker and Kubernetes.
go.why_now: Cloud-native infrastructure and AI backend scaling require Go's speed.
go.situation: The industrial-strength choice for backend systems.

javascript.title: JavaScript Language Path
javascript.description: The language of the web, now running full-scale AI apps in the browser.
javascript.why_now: Web-based AI interfaces are the primary user touchpoint.
javascript.situation: Universal foundation; value shifting to AI integration.

typescript.title: TypeScript Language Path
typescript.description: JavaScript with types — the professional standard for high-scale app development.
typescript.why_now: Scaling large AI products requires the safety and reliability of types.
typescript.situation: Replacing raw JavaScript in all serious enterprise products.

java.title: Java Language Path
java.description: The enterprise workhorse used by the world's largest banks and systems.
java.why_now: Modernizing legacy enterprise systems with AI needs Java experts.
java.situation: Rock-solid enterprise demand; high barrier to entry.

cpp.title: C++ Language Path
cpp.description: The language of absolute hardware performance and low-level control.
cpp.why_now: Optimizing LLM inference (llama.cpp) requires deep C++ knowledge.
cpp.situation: Niche but elite; used when 'speed is everything'.

kotlin.title: Kotlin Language Path
kotlin.description: Modern language for Android and backend development.
kotlin.why_now: Preferred language for modern mobile AI apps on Android.
kotlin.situation: The gold standard for Android development.

swift.title: Swift & SwiftUI Path
swift.description: The beautiful, powerful language for all Apple platforms.
swift.why_now: Spatial computing and Apple Intelligence are built on Swift.
swift.situation: Strong demand within the high-value Apple ecosystem.

php.title: Modern PHP & Laravel
php.description: Building rapid web applications with the most popular backend language.
php.why_now: Laravel is the best stack for rapid prototyping AI SaaS products.
php.situation: Massive legacy base; perfect for solo entrepreneurs.

sql.title: SQL & Data Management
sql.description: The language of data; mastery of querying and database architecture.
sql.why_now: Even AI-native data systems rely on foundational SQL knowledge.
sql.situation: Essential literacy for any data/software role.

docker-k8s.title: Docker & Kubernetes Path
docker-k8s.why_now: The foundation for deploying AI clusters and scalable Microservices.
docker-k8s.situation: The baseline for modern infra jobs.

aws.title: AWS Cloud Mastery
aws.description: Learn the world's most dominant cloud platform.
aws.why_now: Most AI production workloads run on AWS Bedrock and Sagemaker.
aws.situation: Most valuable cloud certification on the market.

data-structures.title: DSA & CS Fundamentals
data-structures.description: Master the logic behind efficient computing and high-scale problem-solving.
data-structures.why_now: Syntax changes, but logic and efficiency are forever. FAANG interviews still demand this.
data-structures.situation: The 'Gym' for programmers. Mandatory for top-tier roles.

langchain.title: LangChain & RAG Systems
langchain.description: Building knowledge-connected AI apps using Retrieval Augmented Generation.
langchain.why_now: RAG is the #1 architecture for business AI today.

api-security.title: API Security Path
api-security.description: Master the art of securing the communication lines of the modern internet.
api-security.why_now: AI hacking often targets poorly secured model APIs.
api-security.situation: High demand in FinTech and Healthcare.
